what: Casting the read-aloud voices: every plausible Kokoro-82M v1.0 fp32 English voice on four of the game's kinds of line, scored as the research scored (docs/evidence/read-aloud/scripts/cast.py): Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 word error rate and UTMOS22 predicted MOS. Proxies: nobody listened.

lines.news: A rider has come in from Gonzales. The Mexican soldiers came for the cannon, and the settlers told them to come and take it.
lines.army: The volunteers are gathering on the Guadalupe. Will you send someone to join them, or keep everyone home to bring in the corn?
lines.rider: I rode from Gonzales this morning. They have buried the cannon in a peach orchard, and they mean to keep it.
lines.mother: Take the children to the wagon. We leave before dark, and we will not see this house again.
